title: Detection of muscle stem cell-derived myonuclei in murine overloaded muscles
author: Kaneshige, Kaji, et al.
materials:
Timing: 10 min
4.Prepare the EdU solution.a.Dissolve EdU to 2.5 mg/mL in sterilized PBS and store at −20°C.Note: To avoid repeated freeze and thaw, the 2.5 mg/mL EdU stock solution can be stored in 200–500 μL volume aliquots in a microcentrifuge tube. Then, only the amount of diluted solution needed for the day can be prepared. The stocked solution is used within approximately 6 months.b.Thaw aliquot and dilute the 2.5 mg/mL EdU stock solution to 0.5 mg/mL with sterilized PBS before administration into mice. Only the amount of 0.5 mg/mL EdU solution needed for the day is prepared.

steps.title: Sterilize surgical instruments
steps.instruction: Autoclave two scissors, one micro‑scissors, two curve‑end forceps, and one needle holder at 120 °C for 20 min, then dry the instruments for 16–24 h.

substeps.instruction: Place instruments in autoclave (120 °C, 20 min).
Dry autoclaved instruments for 16–24 h.

steps.title: Prepare anesthesia cocktail
steps.instruction: Prepare the anesthesia cocktail according to the recipes listed in the Materials and Equipment section.

steps.title: Prepare EdU injection solution
steps.instruction: Dissolve EdU to 2.5 mg/mL in sterilized PBS, aliquot 200–500 µL into microcentrifuge tubes, store at –20 °C (use within ~6 months). On the day of injection, thaw an aliquot and dilute with sterilized PBS to 0.5 mg/mL; prepare only the volume needed for that day.

substeps.instruction: Make 2.5 mg/mL EdU stock in PBS; aliquot 200–500 µL; store at –20 °C.
Thaw one aliquot and dilute to 0.5 mg/mL with PBS; use immediately.

steps.title: Knead tragacanth gum for fixation
steps.instruction: Knead 5 g tragacanth gum powder with 10 mL H₂O or PBS until the consistency resembles an earlobe, load the kneaded gum into a 10 mL syringe with the tip cut off, store at 4 °C, and use ~500 mg per muscle within one month.

substeps.instruction: Mix 5 g gum powder with 10 mL H₂O or PBS while kneading.
Load the kneaded gum into a 10 mL syringe (tip cut off).
Store the syringe at 4 °C; use within one month.

steps.title: Cut cork to appropriate size
steps.instruction: Trim a suitable cork to approximately 4 mm height and 11–13 mm diameter; avoid soft corks that deform when pinched.

steps.title: Sterilize dissection instruments
steps.instruction: Autoclave two scissors and two forceps at 120 °C for 20 min, then dry for 16–24 h.

substeps.instruction: Place scissors and forceps in autoclave (120 °C, 20 min).
Dry autoclaved instruments for 16–24 h.

steps.title: Make 4% PFA solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.2 g paraformaldehyde powder, add 5 mL PBS, warm to 60–70 °C, vortex every 20–30 min until fully dissolved (≈3–4 h), then keep the 4% PFA solution on ice; prepare only the volume needed for the day (1 mL per slide).

substeps.instruction: Weigh 0.2 g PFA and add 5 mL PBS.
Warm mixture to 60–70 °C.
Vortex every 20–30 min for 3–4 h until dissolved.
Keep the solution on ice.

steps.title: Make 5% skim milk solution
steps.instruction: Weigh 0.2 g skim milk powder, add 4 mL PBS, mix well, keep on ice, and prepare at least 200–300 µL for ten sections (prepare only the amount needed for the day).

substeps.instruction: Weigh 0.2 g skim milk and add 4 mL PBS.
Mix thoroughly.
Keep the solution on ice.

steps.title: Set cryostat temperature
steps.instruction: Confirm or set the cryostat to –25 °C for skeletal muscle sectioning.

steps.title: Section plantaris muscle cryosections
steps.instruction: Retrieve plantaris muscles from –80 °C storage, place in the cryostat for 10 min equilibration, and cut transverse 6 µm sections onto silane‑coated slides; cut at least 1 mm of the proximal side, collect non‑sequential 10 sections per muscle (total 40 sections per slide). Transport samples on dry ice if not adjacent to the cryostat.

substeps.instruction: Remove muscles from –80 °C freezer and place in cryostat.
Equilibrate for 10 min.
Cut 6 µm transverse sections onto silane‑coated slides.
Trim ≥1 mm of proximal muscle, collect 10 non‑sequential sections per muscle (40 per slide).

steps.title: Dry slides and add hydrophobic barrier
steps.instruction: Dry slides for 30 min at 15–25 °C, trace around each set of sections 2–3 times with a PAP pen within 30 min, then dry the barrier completely for 5 min at 15–25 °C.

substeps.instruction: Dry slides 30 min at 15–25 °C.
Trace around sections 2–3 times with PAP pen (within 30 min).
Dry barrier 5 min at 15–25 °C.

steps.title: Fix sections with PFA
steps.instruction: Cover each slide with ~1 mL 4% PFA in PBS, incubate 10 min at 15–25 °C, then wash three times with 80–100 mL PBS containing 0.1 % Triton X in a staining jar.

substeps.instruction: Add ~1 mL 4% PFA per slide; incubate 10 min (15–25 °C).
Wash slides 3× with 80–100 mL PBS + 0.1 % Triton X.

steps.title: Permeabilize sections with Triton X
steps.instruction: Treat slides with ~0.5 mL PBS containing 0.5 % Triton X, incubate 20 min at 15–25 °C, then wash three times with PBS.

substeps.instruction: Add ~0.5 mL PBS + 0.5 % Triton X per slide; incubate 20 min (15–25 °C).
Wash slides 3× with PBS.

steps.title: Stain EdU using Click‑iT kit
steps.instruction: Prepare the Click‑iT® EdU reaction cocktail per the manufacturer’s instructions, cover sections with ~0.5 mL cocktail, incubate 30 min in the dark at 15–25 °C, then wash three times with 80–100 mL PBS containing 0.1 % Triton X.

substeps.instruction: Make Click‑iT reaction cocktail as directed.
Add ~0.5 mL cocktail per slide; incubate 30 min in dark (15–25 °C).
Wash slides 3× with 80–100 mL PBS + 0.1 % Triton X.

steps.title: Block sections with skim milk
steps.instruction: Cover sections with ~0.5 mL 5 % skim milk in PBS and incubate 1 h in the dark at 15–25 °C.

steps.title: Apply primary anti‑dystrophin antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute rabbit anti‑dystrophin polyclonal antibody 1:800 in 5 % skim milk (≈0.5 mL per slide), cover sections, incubate in a humidified chamber in the dark at 4 °C for 12–16 h, then wash three times with 80–100 mL PBS + 0.1 % Triton X.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1:800 antibody dilution in 5 % skim milk (~0.5 mL/slide).
Incubate slides in humidified chamber, dark, 4 °C, 12–16 h.
Wash slides 3× with 80–100 mL PBS + 0.1 % Triton X.

steps.title: Apply secondary fluorescent antibody
steps.instruction: Dilute donkey anti‑rabbit Alexa Fluor 488 1:500 in PBS (≈0.5 mL per slide), cover sections, incubate 1 h in the dark at 15–25 °C, then wash three times with 80–100 mL PBS + 0.1 % Triton X.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 1:500 secondary antibody dilution in PBS (~0.5 mL/slide).
Incubate 1 h in dark (15–25 °C).
Wash slides 3× with 80–100 mL PBS + 0.1 % Triton X.

steps.title: Mount slides with DAPI medium
steps.instruction: Add 3–4 drops of VECTASHIELD® mounting medium containing DAPI per slide, place a cover glass, wipe excess medium with tissue paper, and seal the cover glass with nail polish.

substeps.instruction: Apply 3–4 drops VECTASHIELD + DAPI.
Place cover glass.
Wipe excess medium.
Seal with nail polish.
